Sections.Title: Cost Accounting
Sections.Comments: WENZHOU-KEAN STUDENTS ONLY. ACCT seniors only.
Sections.CourseDescription: Cost accounting introduces students to powerful tools and techniques used by accountants to determine the cost of providing a service as well as generating performance reports for management to perform their functions of planning, controlling and decision making. Students will develop an effective cost accounting system that provides information that is used for various purposes in different types of business entities. This course will place emphasis on developing various budgets, determining the cost of products and services, performing variance analysis, preparing performance reports and managing costs.

Sections.Title: Fin Accounting & Reporting I
MeetingsDisplay: Sunday, Saturday 9:00 AM - 12:00 PM 1:00 PM - 5:30 PM TBD (Lecture)
Sections.Comments: WENZHOU-KEAN STUDENTS ONLY. MS. Accounting Students ONLY. Meeting days (Subject to change): 9/5/2026, 9/6/2026, 9/12/2026, 9/13/2026, 9/19/2026, 9/20/2026
Sections.CourseDescription: This course is designed to provide students who wish to enroll in the MS in Accounting Program, but does not have any undergraduate accounting courses. The course will provide the students, in a compressed format, the principles of accounting. It will also present the basic financial statements required by generally accepted accounting principles. The course will also provide the students with an appreciation as to how the financial community analyzes some of these financial statements. This course is required of students who have not taken the basic principles of accounting I and II on an undergraduate basis. However, this course can be waived if the student can show comparable business or professional experience. This course is a prerequisite for ACCT 5002 for those students who have not taken intermediate accounting I and II courses as an undergraduate student. Credit for this course is not counted toward the 30 credit hour requirement for the MS in Accounting Degree Program.

Sections.Title: Fin Accounting & Reporting II
MeetingsDisplay: Sunday, Saturday 9:00 AM - 12:00 PM 1:00 PM - 5:30 PM TBD (Lecture)
Sections.Comments: WENZHOU-KEAN STUDENTS ONLY. MS. Accounting Students ONLY. Meeting days (Subject to change): 10/10/2026, 10/11/2026, 10/17/2026, 10/18/2026, 10/24/2026, 10/25/2026
Sections.CourseDescription: A continuing study of financial accounting and reporting Issues. An in-depth coverage of the components of the Balance Sheet, Income Statement, Statement of Changes in Owners' Equity and Cash Flows. Detailed treatment of accounting principles and concepts including revenue recognition and accounting for taxes, leases and pension plans.

Sections.Title: Accounting for Managers
MeetingsDisplay: Sunday, Saturday 9:00 AM - 12:00 PM 1:00 PM - 5:30 PM TBD (Lecture)
Sections.Comments: WENZHOU-KEAN STUDENTS ONLY. GMBA First Year 2026 Cohort ONLY. Meeting days are subject to change
Sections.CourseDescription: This course will focus on accounting as an information system that benefits users such as investors, creditors, managers, governmental regulators and other interested parties. This course includes financial accounting with an emphasis on the conceptual framework of accounting, the bookkeeping process of accounting, and financial statements presentation and analysis. The managerial segment focuses on managerial accounting tools used for decision making, the foundation of managerial accounting, ethical issues, operations planning and control and performance evaluation.

Sections.Title: Fin. Acct. for Corporations
MeetingsDisplay: Wednesday 9:00 AM - 12:00 PM 1:00 PM - 5:30 PM TBD (Lecture)
Sections.Comments: WENZHOU-KEAN STUDENTS ONLY. MS. Accounting Students ONLY. Meeting days (Subject to change): 11/4/2026, 11/11/2026, 11/18/2026, 11/25/2026, 12/2/2026, 12/9/2026
Sections.CourseDescription: This course covers a broad spectrum of advanced accounting topics, including business combinations and consolidations, intercompany accounting, multinational enterprises, foreign currency transactions and translation, partnerships including formulation and liquidation, government and not-for-profit entities, and SEC reporting. Current FASB and GASB pronouncements are included with special emphasis to assist in preparations for the CPA examination. Ethical considerations in business are a primary theme.

Sections.Title: Managerial and Cost Acct
MeetingsDisplay: Sunday 9:00 AM - 12:00 PM 1:00 PM - 5:30 PM TBD (Lecture)
Sections.Comments: WENZHOU-KEAN STUDENTS ONLY. MS. Accounting Students ONLY. Meeting days (Subject to change): 11/1/2026, 11/8/2026, 11/15/2026, 11/22/2026, 11/29/2026, 12/6/2026
Sections.CourseDescription: Managerial and Cost Accounting introduces students to powerful tools and techniques used by accountants to generate reliable and relevant information for all levels of management to perform their functions of planning, controlling and decision making. In this course students will learn how an effective cost accounting system provides information that can impact operational and financial performances of an entity. Students will also learn how managerial and cost accounting information are developed and used for various purposes in different types of business entities. This course will place emphasis on managerial accounting systems that play a proactive role in planning, organizing, controlling and costs reduction.

Sections.Title: China Tax
MeetingsDisplay: Saturday 9:00 AM - 12:00 PM 1:00 PM - 5:30 PM TBD (Lecture)
Sections.Comments: WENZHOU-KEAN STUDENTS ONLY. MS. Accounting Students ONLY. Meeting days (Subject to change): 9/5/2026, 9/12/2026, 9/19/2026, 10/10/2026, 10/17/2026, 10/24/2026
Sections.CourseDescription: This course will introduce the China Tax system to Master of Accounting students and provide an understanding of the major principles and technical areas of individual and enterprise taxation in mainland China. The course will cover the basic taxes, such as the individual and enterprise income tax, resident and non-resident income taxes, value added tax, consumption tax, customs duties and the land appreciation tax on the disposal of property.
